def solve(x1, y1, x2, y2)
  29.downto(0) do |i|
    bx1 = x1 / POW3[i]
    bx2 = x2 / POW3[i]
    by1 = y1 / POW3[i]
    by2 = y2 / POW3[i]
    if bx1 != bx2
      return (x1 - x2).abs
    end
    if bx1 == 1 && (by1 - by2).abs > 1
      l1 = x1 - POW3[i] + 1
      l2 = x2 - POW3[i] + 1
      return {l1 + l2, POW3[i] * 2 + 2 - l1 - l2}.min
    end
    x1 -= bx1 * POW3[i]
    x2 -= bx2 * POW3[i]
  end
  return (x1 - x2).abs
end

program fractal_shortest_path
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: n = 30
  integer :: q, i, k
  integer(8) :: a, b, c, d, pow(0:n) = 0, p, x, y, z, w, m, s, t
  logical :: fx, fy
  pow(0) = 1
  do i = 1, n
    pow(i) = pow(i - 1) * 3
  end do
  read(*,*) q
  do i = 1, q
    read(*,*) a, b, c, d
    a = a - 1
    b = b - 1
    c = c - 1
    d = d - 1
    do k = n, 0, -1
      p = pow(k)
      x = a / p
      y = b / p
      z = c / p
      w = d / p
      fx = x == z .and. mod(x, 3) == 1 .and. abs(y - w) >= 2
      fy = y == w .and. mod(y, 3) == 1 .and. abs(x - z) >= 2
      if (fx .or. fy) then
        if (fx) then
          s = mod(a, p)
          t = mod(c, p)
          m = abs(d - b)
        else
          s = mod(b, p)
          t = mod(d, p)
          m = abs(c - a)
        end if
        m = m + min(s + t + 2, p * 2 - s - t)
        goto 100
      end if
    end do
    m = abs(c - a) + abs(d - b)
    100 write(*,'(i0)') m
  end do

    integer(8), intent(in) :: a, b, c, d
    res = abs(c - a) + abs(d - b) + max(extra(a - 1, b - 1, c - 1, d - 1), &
      extra(b - 1, a - 1, d - 1, c - 1)) * 2
  end
  integer(8) function extra(x1, y1, x2, y2) result(res)
    integer(8), intent(in) :: x1, y1, x2, y2
    integer(8) :: t, tmp
    integer :: i
    res = 0
    t = 1
    do i = 1, 32
      if (x1 / t == x2 / t .and. between(x1 / t, y1 / t, y2 / t)) then
        tmp = min(min(mod(x1, t), mod(x2, t)) + 1, &
          t - max(mod(x1, t), mod(x2, t)))
        res = max(res, tmp)
      end if
    end do
  end
  logical function between(x, y1, y2) result(res)
    integer(8), intent(in) :: x, y1, y2
    integer(8) :: a, b1, b2, b
    res = .false.
    b1 = min(y1, y2) + 1
    b2 = max(y1, y2) - 1
    if (y1 > y2) return
    do while (a > 0)
      if (mod(a, 3) == 1) then
        if (y2 - y1 > 3) then
          res = .true.
          return
        end if
        do b = b1, b2
          if (mod(b, 3) == 1) then
            res = .true.
            return
          end if
        end do
      end if
      a = a / 3
      b1 = b1 / 3
      b2 = b2 / 3

  end

main :: IO ()
main = do
  q <- readLn
  res <- getVecURest q $ liftA2 query rPt rPt
  printVecInLines res
  return ()
  where
    rInt1 = subtract 1 <$> rIntL
    rPt = liftA2 (,) rInt1 rInt1

query :: (Int,Int) -> (Int,Int) -> Int
query p q = dist p q + 2 * gap p q (findBlock p q)

dist :: (Int,Int) -> (Int,Int) -> Int
dist (!p0,!p1) (!q0,!q1) = abs (p0 - q0) + abs (p1 - q1)

data Dir = Horizontal | Vertical

gap :: (Int,Int) -> (Int,Int) -> Maybe (Dir,Int) -> Int
gap (!p0,!p1) (!q0,!q1) = \case Nothing               -> 0
                                Just (Vertical,  !lv) -> gapInDir p0 q0 lv
                                Just (Horizontal,!lv) -> gapInDir p1 q1 lv

gapInDir :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
gapInDir !p !q !lv = min (mi+1) (pow-ma)
  where
    !(!ma,!mi) | rp >= rq  = (rp,rq)
               | otherwise = (rq,rp)
    pow = 3^lv
    rp = p `mod` pow
    rq = q `mod` pow

findBlock :: (Int,Int) -> (Int,Int) -> Maybe (Dir,Int)
findBlock (!p0,!p1) (!q0,!q1) = go0 0 p0 p1 q0 q1
  where
    d3 = (`div` 3) :: Int -> Int
    go0 !lv !p0 !p1 !q0 !q1
      | p0 == q0 = go1 lv Vertical   (-1) p0 p1 q1
      | p1 == q1 = go1 lv Horizontal (-1) p1 p0 q0
      | otherwise = go0 (lv+1) (d3 p0) (d3 p1) (d3 q0) (d3 q1)
    go1 !lv !dir !accLv !x !y0 !y1
      | y0 == y1 = if accLv >= 0 then Just (dir,accLv) else Nothing
      | otherwise = go1 (lv+1) dir nextAcc qx (d3 y0) (d3 y1)
      where
        (qx,rx) = divMod x 3
        nextAcc | rx == 1 && abs (y0-y1) >= 2 = lv
                | otherwise                   = accLv

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)

streamMapFoldl :: (Functor m) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> VFSM.Stream m b -> VFSM.Stream m c
{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \r -> case r of
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

data T3 = V0 | V1 | V2

data Strs = Strs { str0 :: {-# UNPACK #-} !(VU.Vector Word8),
                   str1 :: {-# UNPACK #-} !(VU.Vector Word8),
                   str2 :: {-# UNPACK #-} !(VU.Vector Word8) }

{-# INLINE CONLIKE pick #-}

main :: IO ()
main = do
  strs <- liftA3 Strs parseLn parseLn parseLn
  print $ query strs
  return ()
  where parseLn = parse <$> BS.getLine

parse :: BS.ByteString -> VU.Vector Word8
parse bs = VU.map (\c -> if c == quest then 0 else 1 + c - a)
  $ VU.unfoldrN (BSW.length bs) BSW.uncons bs
  where quest = fromIntegral $ ord '?'
        a = fromIntegral $ ord 'a'


query :: Strs -> Int
query strs = minimum $ (`map` permutations [V0,V1,V2]) $ \ [!v0,!v1,!v2] ->
  VU.minimum
  $ VU.map (\ !pos1 -> len v0 v1 v2 pos1 $ findPos2 v0 v1 v2 pos1)
  $ VU.findIndices id $ check v0 v1
  where
    check = prep strs
    pstr = pick strs
    len !v0 !v1 !v2 !pos1 !pos2
      = max (VU.length (pstr v0))
          $ (pos1 +) $ max (VU.length (pstr v1))
                           (pos2 + VU.length (pstr v2))
    findPos2 !v0 !v1 !v2 !pos1
      = fromJust $ VU.findIndex id $ VU.take l
      $ VU.zipWith (&&) (VU.drop pos1 c02 VU.++ VU.replicate l True)
                        (c12              VU.++ VU.replicate l True)
      where
        c02 = check v0 v2
        c12 = check v1 v2
        l = max (VU.length c02 - pos1) (VU.length c12)

-- assumes V.length strs == 3
{-# INLINE prep #-}
prep :: Strs -> (T3 -> T3 -> VU.Vector Bool)
prep strs@Strs{..} = go
  where
    {-# INLINE draw #-}
    draw v = fromMaybe True . (v VU.!?)
    {-# INLINE gen #-}
    gen s0 s1 = VU.map (tryPos2 s0 s1) $ VU.generate (1 + VU.length s0) id
    {-# INLINE go #-}
    go V0 V1 = vec01
    go V0 V2 = vec02
    go V1 V0 = vec10
    go V1 V2 = vec12
    go V2 V0 = vec20
    go V2 V1 = vec21
    go _  _  = undefined
    !vec01 = gen str0 str1
    !vec02 = gen str0 str2
    !vec10 = gen str1 str0
    !vec12 = gen str1 str2
    !vec20 = gen str2 str0
    !vec21 = gen str2 str1

-- assumes given int >= 0
{-# INLINE tryPos2 #-}
tryPos2 :: VU.Vector Word8 -> VU.Vector Word8 -> Int -> Bool
tryPos2 !xs !ys = \ !p ->
  VU.and $ VU.zipWith (\ a b -> a == 0 || b == 0 || a == b)
  (VU.drop p xs) ys

proc warshallFloyd(dist: seq[seq[int]]): seq[seq[int]] =
  let N = dist.len
  var dist = dist
  for k in 0..<N:
    for i in 0..<N:
      for j in 0..<N:
        if dist[i][k] == int.inf or dist[k][j] == int.inf: continue
        let d = dist[i][k] + dist[k][j]
        if dist[i][j] > d: dist[i][j] = d
  return dist

proc dist(s,t:tuple[x,y:int]):int = abs(s.x - t.x) + abs(s.y - t.y)

proc far(s,t:tuple[x,y:int], h:int):int =
  let
    d = 3^(h - 1)
    p = (x:s.x div d, y:s.y div d)
    q = (x:t.x div d, y:t.y div d)
    s1 = (x:s.x mod d, y:s.y mod d)
    t1 = (x:t.x mod d, y:t.y mod d)
  if p.x == 1 and q.x == 1:
    result = int.inf
    block:
      let
        a = (d - 1, 3 * d - 1)
        b = (d - 1, 0)
      result.min=dist(p, a) + 1 + dist(b, q)
    block:
      let
        a = (2 * d, 3 * d - 1)
        b = (2 * d, 0)
      result.min=dist(p, a) + 1 + dist(b, q)
    return
  else:
    return dist(s, (t.x, t.y + d))

proc adj(s,t:tuple[x,y:int], h):int =
  if h == 0:
    return 1
  let
    d = 3^(h - 1)
    p = (x:s.x div d, y:s.y div d)
    q = (x:t.x div d, y:t.y div d)
    s1 = (x:s.x mod d, y:s.y mod d)
    t1 = (x:t.x mod d, y:t.y mod d)
  if p == (1, 2) and q == (1, 0):
    return adj(s1, t1, h - 1)
  else:
    return far(s, t, h - 1)
  return


proc solve(s, t:tuple[x,y:int], h:int):int =
  if h == 0:
    assert(s == t)
    return 0
  let
    d = 3^(h - 1)
    p = (x:s.x div d, y:s.y div d)
    q = (x:t.x div d, y:t.y div d)
    s1 = (x:s.x mod d, y:s.y mod d)
    t1 = (x:t.x mod d, y:t.y mod d)
  if p.x != q.x and p.y != q.y: return dist(s, t)
  if p.x == q.x and p.y == q.y: return solve(s1, t1, h - 1)
  if p.y == q.y: return solve((s.y, s.x), (t.y, t.x), h)
  # p.x == q.x
  if p.y > q.y: return solve(t, s, h)
  # p.y < q.y
  if p.x == 1 and q.x == 1:
    result = int.inf
    block:
      let
        a = (d - 1, d - 1)
        b = (d - 1, 2 * d)
      result.min=dist(p, a) + dist(a, b) + dist(b, q)
    block:
      let
        a = (2 * d, d - 1)
        b = (2 * d, 2 * d)
      result.min=dist(p, a) + dist(a, b) + dist(b, q)
    return
  if abs(q.y - p.y) > 1:
    return far(s1, t1, h) + d
  else:
    return adj(s1, t1, h)

  ab=3*((0--b//m)-1)+(0--a//m)

    return [0,ans]
  if ab==1:

      ans=abs(m-d)
      d=m
      return [1,ans,[a,b,c,d]]
    if cd==2 or cd==3:

  if ab==2 and cd==3:

  if ab==4 and cd==7:

    return [1,ans,[a,b,c,d]]
  if ab==8 and cd==9:

    b-=mm
    d-=mm
    ans=abs(m-c)
    c=m
    return [1,ans,[a,b,c,d]]
  ans=abs(a-c)+abs(b-d)
  return [0,ans]

def solve(A, B, C, D):

    detour = 0
    for level in range(29, -1, -1):
        a, b = source[level]
        c, d = dest[level]

                # Best move is to just move to sideways to the axis of blockage.
                # Edges of the fractal are always blank so just need manhattan distance to reach it.
                move1 = sum(
                    (source[l][axis] + dest[l][axis]) * (3 ** l) for l in range(level)
                )
                move2 = sum(
                    (2 - source[l][axis] + 2 - dest[l][axis]) * (3 ** l)
                    for l in range(level)
                )
                detour += min(move1, move2) + 2
                break
    ans = abs(A - C) + abs(B - D) + detour
    return ans

def solve(a, b, c, d):
    """ Lv.i の中央の■を、上下(a,c)に迂回する """
    for i in range(30, 0, -1):

        d3i = d3[i - 1]
        da, ma = divmod(a, d3i)

        if (abs(db - dd) < 2):
            a, c = ma, mc

fn decode(v: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut ret = vec![];
    let mut buf = 0;
    let mut tbl = vec![64; 256];
    for i in 0..64 { tbl[TBL[i] as usize] = i as u8; }
    for (i, c) in v.bytes().filter_map(|c| { let c = tbl[c as usize]; if c < 64 { Some(c) } else { None } }).enumerate() {
        match i % 4 {
            0 => buf = c << 2,
            1 => { ret.push(buf | c >> 4); buf = c << 4; }
            2 => { ret.push(buf | c >> 2); buf = c << 6; }
            3 => ret.push(buf | c),
            _ => unreachable!(),
        }
    }
    ret

        match i % 4 {
            0 => buf = c << 2,
            1 => { ret.push(buf | c >> 4); buf = c << 4; }
            2 => { ret.push(buf | c >> 2); buf = c << 6; }
            3 => ret.push(buf | c),
            _ => unreachable!(),
        }
    }
    ret
